searchText: I would also avoid bundling at this stage. I think the CFI target should be 2 things: - segmentation supporting commitment in the bid - segmentation in the diffusion All other things are compromises down the line, including the complexity dimension. It should be future compatible with BiB when it comes to chunking. Otherwise this has to change later on, which would suck. I still have to understand what exactly you mean by future compatibility there. Regarding the BAL, I think there is no question we want to segment the BALs too. My main question is why BALs should have a priority. I've seen the reasoning in the EIP, but I don't necessarily agree. I can start execution when I have the transactions. I can't start execution when I have the BALs. Once I have both, of course I can use the BAL to parallelize the exectiuon, but I can also do that in other ways, without the BAL, and then use the BAL if and when it is available.
